Height: 5 foot 6 inches
SW: 252lbs
CW: 199.6lbs
Goal: 170lbs

I started this in 2021 when I hit my heaviest to date after Covid - but lost a lot of steam trying to do crash diets and going up and down the moment we stopped “dieting”. We decided to slowly change our life style, learn about nutrition, and make sustainable changes. I really committed last year after some health scares and realizing that if I don’t fix it now - it’s just going to compound.

I stuck to 1500-1800 calories a day + swimming or walking. I focus on protein and fiber every day. I followed a lot of amazing recipes from the flexible diet lifestyle app. I didn’t track on vacations which set me back but I’m not passing up fresh pastries in France!
Today I hit the goal I had set in 2021 - but have decided to keep going! I’d love to body recomp now as well and start building muscle and endurance.

Things that are NSV:
Best blood work in my life
I can keep up with my nephews
Plane travel is much more comfortable
I’m not afraid to sit in plastic chairs
I actually like to walk and clear my head
My hair is shiny & filling in
I’m not afraid to sign up for turkey trots
Thanks to everyone for helping me and cheering for me in this subreddit!
